description: This source file defines the CosmosClusteringProviderBuilder class, which implements configuration logic for integrating Cosmos DB clustering in Orleans Silo and Client builders. It includes methods to configure clustering options based on external configuration sections, and registers provider attributes for Orleans hosting.

classes.name: CosmosClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that implements provider configuration for Orleans clustering with Cosmos DB, supporting both silo and client configurations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the silo builder with Cosmos clustering options based on the provided configuration section.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the client builder with Cosmos gateway list provider options based on the provided configuration section.
